title: Jeremiah Babe’s AI Stock Warning: Claims vs. Evidence
description:
Jeremiah Babe’s October 16, 2026, upload warns that investors are dumping AI stocks, but the supplied evidence does not establish the scale of that selling. We examine that warning alongside Steven Van Metre’s October 15 AI-company warning, keeping creator claims separate from verified market outcomes. The takeaway for U.S. investors is to review concentrated exposure and cash needs rather than treat alarming forecasts as certain losses. What percentage of your investment portfolio is in AI-related stocks?

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
